proposition: The Timurid-Mughal chapter, searched by name, does not mention Bāysunghur at all; its Timurid figures are Iskandar, Shāhrukh, Ulugh Beg and, later, Mughals. So it offers nothing on Bāysunghur's relation to lettrism or to Ibn Turka.

mediation.note: silence based on a name search of the extracted text, not on reading every page
